correctness.rationale: Alternating 6x6 matrices have ranks 0,2,4,6. Fourier diagonalization of translation-invariant rank^t has three nonzero frequency sectors. Independent GF(2) enumeration over ALL 32768 alternating matrices recovered rank multiplicities (651,18228,13888) and exact Fourier shell triples (139,308,-448),(11,-76,64),(-21,84,-64) for dual ranks 2,4,6. The proof counts isotropic 2-planes and radical-containing forms for arbitrary prime powers, derives a_r,b_r,c_r, and shows Lambda_2,Lambda_6 strictly decrease while Lambda_4 strictly increases from -1 to +infinity. The single root is the exact sharp beta_q; its rank-four dual Fourier multiplicity gives endpoint Hilbert dimension q^15-1-M q²(q-1)(q³-1), M={6 choose2}_q. The first derivative at 0 yields beta_q~1/(q^7 log(3/2)). The all-field proof is analytic, not inferred from GF2 enumeration.

Its complete primary document was not available from arXiv or lawful OA search, and authorized institutional request returned vpn_disconnected.
